finding: Each original raster visibly joins the tokens on either side of U+000D into one word on one line. CRLF and LF still produce line separation in the same fields. This is not merely PyMuPDF extraction normalization.
impact: A lone CR used to separate lines or words in a saved note/explanation loses that visual boundary in the printable report. Exact DOM textContent, saved record bytes and overall word accounting do not qualify faithful visible separation.
